verdict.rationale: 2FAS is an authenticator, password manager and secure-sharing product, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that calls other servers' tools is outside its product category. The evidence shows only agent-readable docs (llms.txt, .md mirrors) and states 'Public API: None'. Nothing shows the product consuming MCP servers, so the axis does not flip to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
